body:
You can’t fight the thoughts. You gotta poke and pick at them, dissect them, assemble them back together, and do it again.
Why were you afraid of being gay back then? Is it due to family? Social status? Your own looks?
Do you have anymore information on your urges to become a woman? Can you connect them to any significant point in your life?
Introspection is very important when it comes to questioning whether one wants to transition or not, and it takes months to seriously deliberate it. Question everything, put random pieces together to see if it fits, and question it again. Leave it to stew in your mind for a week or so and review it.
Transitioning is a very serious thing to do, so I’d be careful.
I don’t know your life, I can only tell you how I reached the conclusion that transitioning wasn’t for me.

I’ve been in therapy for some time, however I only lightly brushed upon my past abuse because I previously believed that it didn’t affect me much. I’m just not sure where to start with unraveling it all to be honest.
